t: The Chisel-Strike Evolution: Building Self-Aware Tools and Unlocking AI's Semantic Sight with the Accessibility Tree
s: This article details a 'chisel-strike' refactoring effort, moving from monolithic, manually managed tools to a self-organizing Python package. This evolution enables AI agents to achieve semantic web understanding via the accessibility tree by transforming code infrastructure into embedded intelligence.
sub: Transition from monolithic tools to self-organizing Python packages
Leveraging the accessibility tree for AI semantic sight
Evolution of tools like grep and vi/nvim
Automated tool discovery via `@auto_tool` decorators and `__init__.py`
